## Accounts
Bank accounts, portfolios, fixed deposits: open, change, look up the current interest rate on the web, reconcile the balance, close.
- "Close the Testbroker Cash current account, closing date today."
- "Open a new Eichenbank current account, I am the holder, no interest."
- "Reconcile my Lindenbank Giro: according to the banking app the balance today is exactly 1,234.56 euros."

## Bookings & transfers
Book expenses/income, transfer between your own accounts, reverse wrong bookings.
- "I paid 85 euros for groceries with the Lindenbank Giro today. Please book it as an expense."
- "Transfer 500 euros from the Lindenbank Giro to the Testbroker Cash current account, date today."
- "Reverse my last booking on the Lindenbank Giro."

## Portfolio & securities
Stock/ETF/crypto purchases and sales, dividends, savings plans.
- "Book a dividend of 12.50 euros for my Vanguard FTSE All-World position (VWCE) in the Testbroker portfolio to the Testbroker Cash current account, date today."
- "The broker executed my VWCE savings plan today: 0.44 shares at 113.50 euros per share, order fee 0 euros."
- "Buy 10 shares of Vanguard FTSE All-World (ISIN IE00BK5BQT80, symbol VWCE) in the Testbroker portfolio at 110 euros per share, order fee 1 euro, purchase date today."

## Loans
Record loans, book instalments, change terms, repay early.
- "Book the monthly instalment for my mortgage, instalment 1,200 euros, date today."
- "My Buchenbank mortgage has a new interest rate of 4.1% after the fixed-rate period ended. Please update it."

## Insurance
Record policies with their premium, change them, cancel them.
- "Cancel my Lindenversicherung household contents insurance."
- "Record a new liability insurance with Lindenversicherung, policy number Lindenversicherung-9876, annual premium 89 euros, the holder is my wife, debited from the Lindenbank Giro, valid from 1 Jan 2026, paid yearly on the 15th, first debit on 15 Jan 2026."
- "The annual premium of my Lindenversicherung household contents insurance goes up to 95 euros. Please update it."

## Retirement provision
Record state/occupational/private pensions as assets.
- "Record my Rürup pension with Eichenversicherung, current surrender value 12,000 euros (as of today), monthly contribution 200 euros from the Lindenbank Giro, debit day 1."

## Real estate
Add property as an asset, revalue it, sell it; with living area and year built, the maintenance reserve per II. BV.
- "Please delete the property 'Musterimmobilie' completely from my net worth overview, I don't need it any more."
- "Update the value of my Musterimmobilie to 350,000 euros."

## Savings goals
Savings goals with a target amount/date and an automatically calculated savings rate; an ongoing maintenance reserve for a property.
- "Create a new savings goal 'Emergency fund': target 10,000 euros by the end of 2027, from the Lindenbank Giro into Tagesgeld Plus, debit day 1, first booking on 1 Jul 2026."

## Standing orders
Manage recurring payments (salary, rent, subscriptions, pension); from a bank export the bot suggests missing standing orders. The bot only records standing orders and savings plans; you set them up at your bank yourself.
- "Add a recurring expense: Netflix subscription, 13.99 euros monthly from the Lindenbank Giro, debit day 5, first payment on 5 Jul 2026."
- "Record my monthly standing order: 200 euros from the Lindenbank Giro to the Testbroker Cash current account, from 1 Jul 2026, on the 1st of the month."
- "Which subscriptions and standing orders am I still missing?"

## Import
Import bank statements/policies/pension statements as a photo or as bulk data.

## Advice & planning
The financial adviser gives recommendations, answers “is it worth it?/should I?”, researches with dated sources on the web and maintains your financial plan (interview + quarterly review).

## Questions & reports
Ask directly for figures: account balance, net worth overview, monthly cash flow, remaining debt (“what is my balance on the Lindenbank Giro?”).
